local_development.candidates: all item_features catalogue IDs; never infer candidates from validation purchases
local_development.metric: MRR@100 across all labeled sessions, including retrieval misses
local_development.split_unit: whole session; both views and purchase must be inside the relevant time partition
local_development.notes: Local validation differs from the official random prefix truncation and candidate set, so published leaderboard MRR is not directly comparable. No May or official test results available.

reference_environment.plan: Use isolated Linux environment for original code; do not downgrade the existing training environment. AutoDL host/GPU/memory budget requires measured workload and user-provided server access.
